owner: CFO Margin and Cost Teachers + CFO / Pricing Controller
purpose: Make CFO logic shared across all projects so workers understand cost, margin, risk and break-even before promising or building.

universal_cfo_rules.rule: Build time is a cost even when AI agents do the work.
universal_cfo_rules.qa_block: No product gate advance without expected cost or no-cost reason.
Price claims with no source_url, checked_at and confidence become manual_review.
15-25 EUR parts must be automated, bundled, skipped or justified by demand.

universal_cfo_rules.rule: Paid tools require CFO approval before spend.
universal_cfo_rules.qa_block: No paid external cost without approval, linked revenue path and cap.

universal_cfo_rules.rule: Optional projects must show P0 impact and break-even before promotion.
universal_cfo_rules.qa_block: Optional project cannot consume P0 build capacity without CFO value case.

project_cost_models.margin_logic: Sell audit/pilot first; full marketplace only after one-seller proof and revenue signal.
Scope stays narrow; custom promises quoted separately.
project_cost_models.break_even_signal: One paid 299 EUR pilot covers first sprint validation.

project_cost_models.margin_logic: No paid data/provider spend until revenue or CFO approval.
project_cost_models.break_even_signal: One paid monitoring client or approved internal value case.

project_cost_models.margin_logic: Start with zero-tool-spend sample sprint; paid tools only after paid sprint.
Keep parked until channel moat and monetization path justify cost.
project_cost_models.break_even_signal: Validated audience + low-cost production loop + revenue path.

project_cost_models.project: Android Market Advisor / Investment Advisor App
project_cost_models.margin_logic: Internal tool only until risk/compliance and data cost plan exists.
project_cost_models.break_even_signal: Internal decision value or safe paid product gate.

done_proof: Every offer has price, expected cost, margin and break-even target.
Every paid data/tool idea has approval rule.
Low-value part handling exists in Parts Seller OS rules.
Optional projects stay gated until CFO value case exists.
